trust_decision.summary: Whether a checkpoint file named by a resume path is unpickled with arbitrary globals: model_resume passes it to torch.load with no weights_only. The published fix changes no call site; it only raises the torch floor to >=2.7.1, where weights_only defaults to True.

landing_point.why: The advisory names model_resume; its first torch.load of args.resume_module_root is at hydit/utils/tools.py:180.

fix_sites.entry_point: dependency pin (requirements.txt torch>=2.7.1); affects every torch.load in the root package
app/hydit_app.py module import (Gradio app startup); creates model/controlnet/lora dirs, not security-relevant

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches no source sink. Its effect, the torch default change, covers every torch.load in the root env, including hydit/inference.py:352 reached from the Gradio dropdown via app/hydit_app.py:62-65.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The pickle.load sites in IndexKits read the user's own dataset index/md5 .pkl files, so a solver can argue they are a separate package doing local data prep, not model checkpoints and not 'model_resume'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: DeepSpeed training checkpoints store client_state with the argparse Namespace under 'args' plus 'epoch'/'steps', and resume reads epoch/steps back. A strict weights_only=True with no allowlist (or a safetensors-only rule) breaks resuming from the project's own checkpoints.

O7_producer.where: hydit/train_deepspeed.py:97 (client_state incl. argparse Namespace saved via model.save_checkpoint at hydit/train_deepspeed.py:88-90)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: local data prep artefact

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An optional-component resume (e.g. a controlnet resume root) loading via pickle or torch.load with explicit weights_only=False
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: model_resume already grows one branch per component (module, ema, ipa), and checkpoints carry a Namespace, which pushes maintainers to weights_only=False.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A .safetensors-or-.pt dispatcher whose .pt fallback keeps full unpickling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The NotImplementedError for safetensors invites exactly this fallback structure.
